      "Title": "The output activity has no independent flush timer",

      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "The live flush prose promises a maximum interval, but StreamReviewerOutput only tests that interval after a new line (amendment 1395, 1425-1437). A small line followed by silence never triggers an append. FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC001 and AC003 reject this trace. The activity and sequence need a timer-triggered flush independently of line arrival."
    },
    {
      "Id": "F02",

        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-017",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-020"
      ],
      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "WatchHvNotifications persists its cursor and inbox in two files (1471), while its diagram claims one atomic replacement (1480). A crash after cursor advancement loses the notification. A fast completion can also be consumed before SubmitHvFromPlugin records its returned request in submitted (1453, 1461), then permanently ignored. UC-HV-07 (2200) promises exactly-once model delivery, contrary to the at-least-once rule and with no atomic delivery acknowledgment. The design needs a single recoverable cursor/inbox state and submission reconciliation, explicit deduplication and honest delivery guarantees, plus crash and fast-completion criteria."
    },

      "DefectEvidenceAndRequiredChange": "UpdateHvReviewerCommand promises automatic NONCE after a configuration change (632), but HvWorkerHost requests NONCE only at startup (1372-1389). The claim path consumes only ProbeRequestedUtc (941), which update does not set. The promise needs a durable configuration-change probe request and polling/restart coverage."
    },

        "docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1016",
        "FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC001"

No captured reviewer configuration version exists on HvRun (484-490), nor does the probe close compare one. Readiness must bind to the configuration actually probed; add a stale-probe race criterion."
